original_card.first_experiment: Choose one latest uncovered candidate and build a delta coverage map against the selected review. For P104, #5717 changes owned-lifetime assumptions and #5719 covers exact #5713 causal premises; neither automatically transfers to #5718. For BIT, #5679/#5708 need component admission and compatible outer use. Check controls and exact source identity before reuse; stop with one resolved gap or explicit remaining obligation. actual_scope: For the #7838 finite handoff, can one six-coefficient binary polynomial per side recover both adjacent bits of an odd product modulo 64 through a single multiplication?
scope_change_reason: The live #1166 handoff requests a finite encoder and decoder at the known width lower bound. This narrows the investigation to a missing interface witness.
bottleneck_link: A finite changed producer/consumer boundary with both encoders, the channel and the decoder charged. No recursive caller, uniform scaling or selected-frontier gain is claimed.
stop_rule: Stop with a conflict-free width-six code, an exhaustive decoder check and a complete gate invoice, or with a precisely bounded obstruction.
evidence: All 1,024 ordered input pairs, all 309 reachable raw returns, direct ordinary-product and separate irreducible-label checks, gate counts, row separation and truncation/tag controls in verify.py.
